def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        groups=[]; start=0
        for cut in cuts:
            if start < cut: groups.append((start, cut))
            start=cut+1
        if start<n: groups.append((start,n))
        return groups
    row_groups, col_groups = spans(h,sep_rows), spans(w,sep_cols)
    nonsep=[grid[r][c] for ra,rb in row_groups for r in range(ra,rb) for ca,cb in col_groups for c in range(ca,cb)]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(nonsep).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(ra,rb) for c in range(ca,cb)) >= 2 else bg
             for ca,cb in col_groups] for ra,rb in row_groups]
